coach.label: Coach or consultant
rules: A list hook must name its count, and the body must deliver exactly that count.
Close on a lesson recap or a soft offer, not a hard sell.

maker.label: Maker or product seller
rules: Show the thing early; the body carries most of the words.
Give one specific reason to want it before saying where to get it.

local_business.label: Local business
rules: Name the neighbourhood or the visit occasion, never a claim about competitors.
End with how to visit or book.

educator.label: Educator
rules: Answer the hook's question in the first beat after the hook.
Recap the steps at the end.

community.label: Community or personal brand
rules: Invite replies rather than a sales call to action.

entertainer.label: Entertainer
rules: No call to action by default.
